title: Work several alerts at once
summary: Select alerts (or a whole category) and complete, snooze or WhatsApp them together.

steps.title: Menu → Alerts Center
steps.details: What the system detected with the alert rules and the team needs to work on.

steps.title: Select a category
steps.details: The category's checkbox selects all its alerts; you can also check them one by one.

steps.title: Action bar
steps.details: How many are selected and what you can do with all of them together.

steps.title: WhatsApp all
steps.details: Sends the template to those that have a phone; it tells you how many were sent and how many were skipped.

steps.title: Snooze all
steps.details: Snoozes them until the date you choose.
